title: syringa hirsuta
intro: Syringa hirsuta, commonly known as the hairy syringa or hairy lilac, is a plant species in the family Oleaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Syringa hirsuta include its use as an antispasmodic, to relieve spasms in the respiratory and gastrointestinal systems, and as an anti-inflammatory, to soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Syringa hirsuta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
